verificationQueries.sql: select count(*) = 3 as verified from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and tgname in ('organizations_require_owner', 'memberships_retain_owner', 'permissions_retain_owner');

select not has_function_privilege('public', 'flower_private.create_organization(uuid,uuid,text,text)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'flower_private.create_organization(uuid,uuid,text,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('public', 'flower_private.remove_organization_member(uuid,uuid)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'flower_private.remove_organization_member(uuid,uuid)', 'execute') as verified;

rollbackGuidance: Revoke and drop the six authenticated workflow functions, drop the three constraint triggers and their trigger functions, then drop assert_organization_has_owner(uuid). Do not roll back while applications depend on final-owner enforcement.
